messages:
Samir Patel: Quick follow-up to the 'actor surface' RFC — reading it again and have two deployment concerns.
Noelle Chen: +1. which ones?
Samir Patel: 1) long-lived API keys for integrations, 2) service->service delegation semantics for cross-project calls.
Priya Kaur: For (1) do we keep API keys scoped to org only, or allow project-level keys? Tradeoff is admin UX vs blast radius.
Jules Thompson: My leaning: default project-scoped keys for least-privilege, but org admins can create org-scoped service tokens for infra tooling.
Mika Anders: How about a dual-token model: `api_key.project` and `api_key.org` with explicit metadata so we can enforce routing/quotas.
Eli Grant: That needs SDK surface changes. Current SDK assumes a single API_KEY env var. We should keep compatibility with a fallback order.
Samir Patel: Proposal: SDK resolves env vars in order: PROJECT_API_KEY, ORG_API_KEY, LEGACY_API_KEY. Emit warning if legacy used.
Noelle Chen: Also need audit semantics: token type should be recorded in request logs and shown in Console with filter by scope.
Priya Kaur: On delegation: service tokens should be exchangeable for short-lived project-scoped tokens when calling another project's endpoints. Similar to OAuth token exchange.
Jules Thompson: Agree. But watch the token issuance chain. We must prevent unconstrained fan-out: add a max delegation depth + explicit `aud` claim.
deploy-bot: New draft pushed: https://r.redwood-internal/actor-surface/drafts/3
Mika Anders: Example token format (draft):
```
svc:org=redwood:proj=data-platform:actor=svc-collector:scope=ingest:exp=1700000000:sig=...
```
Eli Grant: We should avoid encoding too many decisions in the token string; prefer signed claims in JWT so we can evolve fields.
Samir Patel: Good point. JWT w/ typ claim `redwood_svc` + versioning looks best. Migration plan: v1 legacy tokens valid 12 months, issue v2 by default.
Noelle Chen: Ops concern: rotation and revocation. Need a revocation list that's low-latency for Dedicated and Private envs.
Priya Kaur: For Private deployments, allow local KMS + local revocation checkpointing. For hosted, central CRL with per-tenant caching.
Jules Thompson: Next steps: draft SDK changes (Eli), console UI for token creation (Noelle), and infra design doc for revocation (Mika).
Samir Patel: I'll add a follow-up RFC that enumerates edge cases + migration timeline. Tagging folks: @Eli @Noelle @Mika @Priya
Noelle Chen: Sounds good. I'll block time to prototype console wireframes this week. :thumbsup:
